description: This file manages booking page analytics tags, including event handling, script injection, and communication with analytics applications within a React/Next.js environment.

classes.name: AnalyticApp
classes.description: Type representing an analytic application with guaranteed appData.tag set.

methods.name: getPushEventScript
methods.description: Generates a push event script with a customized content string based on appId and tag.

methods.name: getAnalyticsApps
methods.description: Retrieves analytics applications matching a specific event type.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming events, filters internal events, dispatches push events to window functions, and posts messages to opener window.

methods.name: BookingPageTagManager
methods.description: React component that injects analytics scripts based on event type and manages their rendering.
